remote_only.prompt_instruction: CRITICAL: If the job explicitly states on-site or hybrid, set total score to 0 and SKIP. Must be fully remote.

tech_stack.prompt_instruction: TECH STACK DEPTH (Max {points_allocated} pts): Major weights for [{core_stack}]. Half points for [{secondary_stack}]. Bonus for [{subsystems}].

career_level.prompt_instruction: CAREER BAND (Max {points_allocated} pts): Preferred [{preferred_tiers}]. Less priority for [{senior_tiers}].

domain_bonuses.prompt_instruction: DOMAIN BONUSES (Max {points_allocated} pts): Gaming industry backend [{gaming_industry}] or DevOps [{devops}] get bonus points.
